solution.introduction: We calculate each required quantity systematically.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.working: The image is P'(3, 5).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.working: Reflection in the x-axis changes the required sign(s) while preserving distance.

solution.final_answer: Therefore, The image is P'(3, 5); Reflection in the x-axis changes the required sign(s) while preserving distance.
